title: Unequal Representations: Analyzing Intersectional Biases in Word Embeddings Using Representational Similarity Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Using Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) to compare the representational geometry of word embeddings (GloVe and BERT) for intersectional demographic groups (e.g., Black female names and terms) against hypothesis models to measure marginalization along multiple axes simultaneously.

Probing word embeddings to measure the strength of association between race concepts (e.g., countries, the word 'Black') and specific demographic names/terms using Representational Similarity Analysis.
Probing word embeddings to measure the strength of association between gender concepts (e.g., 'woman', 'female') and specific demographic names/terms using Representational Similarity Analysis.
